scope: Read-only approval of the bounded BF16 child-ready design correction. This permits implementation and its focused tests only; it does not approve source commit, qualification, replay, admission, analyzer execution, build, or launch.

resolution_checks.inventory_equality: Resolved: the actual opaque child's ordered inventory must equal the receipt inventory refs, including ledger, source closure, SHA, and stat metadata; live-ledger None/equality is explicit.
resolution_checks.sidecar_equality: Resolved: the child inherits every parent sidecar and adds exactly the three current dispatch refs as a disjoint union, with exact keys, path/SHA/stat, duplicate rejection, and current-reference checks.
resolution_checks.canonical_parent_receipt: Resolved: the parent receipt path is derived from the reviewed sidecar namespace and stage index, with index type/range, symlink/alias rejection, and stable-read digest binding.
resolution_checks.successor_provenance: Resolved: stage zero has no predecessor; stages one through twenty require an opaque finalized predecessor identity and exact canonical predecessor receipt ref, with bounded recursive metadata-chain validation.
resolution_checks.runtime_authority: Preserved: receipt JSON remains a metadata witness; the guard requires the actual opaque child and pinned graph, and does not reconstruct or deserialize runtime authority.
resolution_checks.guard_placement: Resolved in design: the admission wrapper and supervisor invoke the bridge guard immediately after child creation and again immediately before executor.run_group, retaining the original Popen monotonic lease and no-retry behavior.

implementation_conditions: When copying inherited parent StageRefs into the child, preserve the receipt's witnessed stat/path/SHA and first validate the current file; do not silently replace the witness with freshly discovered metadata.
The dispatch-sidecar mapping must be constructed by the fixed supervisor from the exact admission, phase, and raw-permit refs for the current group; no caller-provided arbitrary mapping may widen it.
The writer must emit status, inventory_refs, sidecar_refs, canonical ledger_ref/live_ledger_ref, and predecessor fields atomically and validate the stage-index/path relation before publication.
The second guard must execute inside the real runtime-loader and frozen-executor guard nesting, immediately before run_group, and both guard failures must prove run_group was not reached.

Implementation tests must include the required positive path and the design's alternate-path, index, inventory, sidecar-union, stat, predecessor-chain, stale-parent, expired-lease, graph, lock, and restoration near misses before any source-commit review.
preserved_limits: No change to the 120-second handshake, 600-second startup allowance, per-attempt lease origin, source/resource/attempt guards, 21 parent stages, 20 child stages, canonical lock, or automatic_retry false semantics.
No serialized diagnostic is accepted as a runtime object, no extra frozen replay is introduced, and no historical source or prior evidence is rewritten.
claim_limits: This is implementation-design approval only. Final source review must inspect the actual bridge/admission/supervisor diff and focused regressions, including parser11-dependent actual frozen-function coverage; no qualification or execution readiness is implied.
